source_description: Synthetic offline workload counters; no customer data or cloud execution.

limitations: Existing memory adapter is not DynamoDB, S3 or production latency acceptance.

Capacity estimates use JSON item-size proxies; no AWS ConsumedCapacity receipt. Canceled transactions conservatively count every submitted action; ConditionCheck follows the general transaction-write rule including a minimum for absent items.
Metadata includes live rate/setup/session rows; TTL removal is not simulated.
Response/body bytes exclude HTTP headers, TLS, CDN functions, static assets and network retries.
Gzip is a measured hypothetical alternative; current S3 objects remain raw JSON.
Successful recovery adds one accepted batch beyond the workload; a capacity-blocked probe is reported as not exercised and never claimed successful.
Alpha 10 MiB cumulative quota and request limits remain active; this does not approve commercial limits.
Existing memory adapter is not DynamoDB, S3 or production latency acceptance.
